status: preregistered local development feasibility trial; documentation, not consumed as config
architecture: frozen original 4-bit localizer + independent FP32 linear binary existence head
feature: L2-normalized final hidden vector at last input-prompt position, image and query only, stop-gradient
initialization: all head weights/biases zero; exact argmax tie selects absent
objective: mean balanced-training-set CE + 0.5 * 0.01 * sum(weight squared); bias unpenalized
optimizer: Adam, learning rate 0.05, full batch of 32 training questions
routing: argmax, no calibrated confidence or validation-tuned threshold; absent renders explicit GAM None; present retains exact frozen-localizer response including any invalid output
evaluation: generate all 40 baseline outputs once as control, then replay independent head routes; no inference-latency-saving claim
note: Different architecture and optimization budget from LoRA, not a single-variable LoRA ablation or final benchmark. Reused synthetic development only; no ground-truth answers in features; no validation fit/normalization statistics.
